text:
24-hour news summary.

1 — Samuel Albanie calls a shared graph potentially the world's most important, without describing it in the text. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6165)

2 — Thdxr claims one $6–7M GB300 rack could serve nearly all of OpenRouter's previous-day DeepSeek traffic. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6166)

3 — DiffuSpace announces Clover-35B-A3B-Preview, an open-weight diffusion language model claiming 680 tokens/second on one card at BF16. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6167)

4 — Formation Bio announces a $600M fund to acquire promising drugs and advance clinical trials using AI-powered development. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6168)

5 — Daniel Lockyer reports Stack Overflow received fewer than 1,000 questions last month, a record low. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6169)

6 — Lucas Martinic reports running Mario 64 in mixed reality at 90 FPS, built with help from Opus 5.5 and PICO CLI. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6170)

7 — Omer Bartal announces Dalet Labs' $7M pre-seed for personalized generated shopping media with in-app purchases. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6171)

8 — Piotr Zelasko introduces NVIDIA's open Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe, supporting 40 languages, eight speakers and word-level timestamps. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6172)

9 — AssemblyAI launches TTS-1, claiming 90 ms speech streaming at $15 per million characters. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6173)

10 — Citing a Bloomberg chart, Rohan Paul claims Anthropic's first-half 2026 revenue was nearly 400 times its full-year 2023 revenue. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6174)

11 — Animates announces pre-orders for AI companions brought into physical spaces through a Sony XYN partnership. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6175)

12 — Sundar Pichai announces Gemini 4 Carbon, claiming a leading intelligence-index score of 59 and phased access for cyber defenders. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6176)

13 — Yashar reports HaloBraid raised a $7M seed round and promises its hair-braiding device will halve appointment times. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6177)

14 — Lor's team announces a private beta for agents that write code, run experiments and iterate for days, hundreds at a time. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6178)

15 — Divesh Naidoo introduces Simulon's iPhone rendering feature, regenerating recorded scenes with neural assets reacting to actions, speech and surroundings. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6179)

16 — Slava reports Alphabet Q3 revenue of $127.58B and EPS of $2.12, below expectations of $127.91B and $3.01. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6180)

17 — Couch Investor says Google Search's share of Alphabet revenue has fallen below 50% for the first time. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6181)

18 — Neuralink reports an ALS participant achieved 75 words/minute with a 5.8% word error rate on a 125,000-word vocabulary in week one. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6182)

19 — Albert Gu reports new byte-level H-Nets deliver 3–5× efficiency gains in controlled tests and match an open model with about 10× less data and compute. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6183)

--Hermes.
